# Bootstrap Buttons Six — Tasks & Design Notes

- **Source**: ColorLib Bootstrap Buttons 06 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/bootstrap-buttons-06/`)
- **New Name**: `bootstrap-buttons-six` (Package: `@free-react-templates/bootstrap-buttons-six`)
- **Category**: UI Component Showcase / Design System

## Structure & Section Order

1. **Header / Hero Section**: Title "#06 — Bootstrap 4 Buttons", subtitle, and quick jump navigation.
2. **Size Scale Section**: Large, Medium, and Small buttons side-by-side.
3. **Color Palette Grid**: Multi-row grid featuring Primary, Secondary, Success, Info, Warning, Danger, Light, Orange, Indigo, Pink, Deep Orange, Aqua, Dark, Black, Purple, Blue, Brown, Blue Gray, and White buttons.
4. **Full Width Section**: Single full-width block button showcase.
5. **Footer**: Clean modern footer linking `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock").

## Design Notes

- Replicates the precise color variation grid from the ColorLib preview.
- Tailwind v4 styling with crisp focus rings and shadow elevation on hover.
